name: WalnutCGB
description: Walnut-CGB — single-header Game Boy / Game Boy Color emulator (MIT), a performance-oriented rewrite of Peanut-GB. Vendored for the NumOS Game Boy app. LOCAL MODIFICATION: the two DMA width macros (WALNUT_GB_16BIT_DMA / WALNUT_GB_32BIT_DMA) are wrapped in #ifndef guards so a desktop build can disable them, as the upstream SDL2 example requires. No other changes.
